REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - FEBRUARY 5, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Community Development Department at (562) 916-1201 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Commissioner or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Wednesday, January 8, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Special Meeting Minutes.
MINUTES
6.
New and Old Business
6A.
Review and consideration of an informational update on the Tuesday, March 4, 2025 Cerritos General Municipal Election.
AGENDA REPORT
6B.
Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos Planning Commission providing an overview of the City of Cerritos 2024 General Plan Annual Progress Report for submittal to the California Governor’s Office of Planning and Research (OPR) and the California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD).
AGENDA REPORT
7.
Reports
7A.
Reports from Designated Commission Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
7B.
Reports from Planning Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
8.
Adjournment

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
February 5, 2025
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703
PRESENT:  Commissioner Gene Burd
  Commissioner Gloria Perlas Pulido
  Commissioner Deepak "DJ" Jhaveri
  Vice Chair Bhavin Gandhi
  Chair Carla Gilhuys

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  City Clerk Cynthia Nava
  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila
  Director of Community & Cultural Services Annie Hylton
  Director of Administrative Services Drew Schneider
  Assistant City Engineer Jared Lee
  Advance Planning Manager Sabrina Chan
  Public Safety Manager Daryl Evans
  Associate Civil Engineer Amandeep Mann
  Management Analyst Mariel Angeles
  Associate Planner Mary Balderrama

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledgeof Allegiance was led by Commissioner Pulido.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  Chair Gilhuys invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed
  on the agenda. Seeingand hearing no one wishing to addressthe Planning
  Commission, Chair Gilhuys closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

SA.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, January 8, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Special Meeting
  Minutes.

City of Cerritos  February 5, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   MOTION: it was moved by Commissioner Jhaveri, and seconded by Vice Chair
  Gandhi, to approve the Wednesday, January 8, 2025, 7:00 p.m. Planning
  Commission Special Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0-1) as follows:
  AYES:  Jhaveri, Pulido, Gandhi, Gilhuys
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT;  None
  ABSTAIN :  Burd

6.  New and Old Business
6A.  REVIEW AND CONSIDERATION OF AN INFORMATIONAL UPDATE ON THE
  TUESDAY. MARCH 4, 2025 CERRITOS GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION.

  A staff report was given by City Clerk Cynthia Nava. A PowerPointpresentation
  was displayed, providing details about the upcoming election. Ms. Nava
  provided information on the upcoming Special State Senate election on
  Tuesday, February 25, 2025 and the City of Cerritos General Municipal Election
  on Tuesday, March 4, 2025, including information related to voter registration
  and methods of voting.

  Chair Gilhuys opened the public comments period. Seeing and hearing no speakers,
  Chair Gilhuys declared public comments closed.

  Additional clarification was provided on pre-registration for voters who are sixteen
  and seventeen years old. Following discussion, the item was received and filed
  accordingly.

6B.  REVIEW AND CONSIDERATION OF AN INFORMATIONAL REPORT TO THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION PROVIDING AN OVERVIEW OF THE CITY
  OF  CERRITOS  2024  GENERAL  PLAN  ANNUAL  PROGRESS  REPORT  FOR
  SUBMITrAL TO THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNOR’SOFFICE OF PLANNING AND
  RESEARCH (OPR) AND CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF HOUSING AND
  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT(HCD).

  A staff report was given by Management Analyst Mariel Angeles. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the 2024 General Plan Annual
  ProgressReport (APR). Ms. Angeles provided background on the City’s adopted
  General Plan and the City’s 2024 General Plan APR, including implementation efforts
  during 2024.

  Chair Gilhuys opened the public comments period. A member of the public, Adrian
  Ayub, provided public comments related to real estate investments and affordable
  housing. Director Aguila provided information related to the City’s efforts in the
  development of affordable housing. Seeing and hearing no other speakers, Chair
  Gilhuys declared public comments closed.

  Further discussion was held on the City’s General Plan Maintenance Fee, General Plan
  Amendment 2005-3, the City’s transit services, and public safety. Following
  discussion, the item was received and filed accordingly.

City of Cerritos  February5, 2025
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison
  Director of Community Development Kristin Aguila encouraged participation in the
  City’s March 4, 2025 election.
7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members
  Reports were given by Commissioners Pulido, Vice Chair Gandhi, and Chair Gilhuys.
8.  Adjournment
  The meeting adjourned at 8:05 p.m.
